'''Wing''' is a horse owned by [[Sheriam Bayanar]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Wing|Wing}}

==Appearance==
Wing is a dappled gray mare.{{ref||Wing}}

==Activities==
Wing carried Sheriam to the meeting with the [[Andor]]an and [[Murandy|Murandian]] nobles, and then back to the [[Rebel Aes Sedai]] camp.{{ref/book|8|17}}{{ref/book|8|19}}
